# Server Survival — pinned original offline port

Original project: [pshenok/server-survival](https://github.com/pshenok/server-survival), pinned to **01796362d3b7bfa6c85efab5e2685f4d955dc137**. [Original MIT license](upstream/LICENSE), copyright (c) 2025 Kostyantyn Pshenychnyy, is retained and also served at `/licenses/server-survival-MIT.txt`.

This is the original Three.js cloud-architecture simulation, not a locally invented simplified imitation. It retains survival, the 25-level/five-chapter campaign, sandbox, 26 service types/five categories, original touch picking/panning/pinch controls, tutorials and the game's own local achievements. Its simulated dollar budget is not the website's office currency. No website account, reward or leaderboard API is added.

## Source and materials

`upstream/` contains the reviewed first-party runtime sources, dependency metadata and original license from the pinned revision. Text is normalized to LF/single final newline with trailing whitespace removed; no gameplay edits are made to these archival inputs. Original upstream documentation is available at the source link rather than copied with links to deliberately excluded media. The original scene and icons are generated by first-party code, with no downloaded texture, model or font at runtime.

- The original CDN Three **r128 / 0.128.0** is locally vendored from official [d4aa9e00ea29808534a3e082f602c544e5f2419c](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/d4aa9e00ea29808534a3e082f602c544e5f2419c). Its exact `build/three.min.js` SHA-256 is `9274bbcec8d96168626c732b5d31c775aa8cfb7eaa0599bec0c175908a2c1ce2`. [Three MIT text](vendor/three-r128-LICENSE) is served at `/licenses/server-survival-three-r128-MIT.txt`. This isolated version does not replace the main application's Three dependency.
- Original Tailwind utility classes are compiled to a static stylesheet with **tailwindcss 3.4.17**; no browser compiler or CDN is shipped. [Tailwind MIT text](vendor/tailwindcss-3.4.17-LICENSE) is served at `/licenses/server-survival-tailwind-MIT.txt`.
- All five original MP3 files and the marketing `gameplay.gif` are **excluded**. They have no separate material-source/rights credits in the reviewed revision; the repository-level MIT declaration alone does not independently establish their upstream provenance. All audio APIs/calls are disabled in this port, including original direct click sounds that bypassed its mute preference. This restriction does not change simulation rules or original graphics.

## Local adapter and rebuild

`adapters/` and [the mechanical rebuild script](../../scripts/build-local-lab-strategy.mjs) adapt only the hosting boundary: classic IIFE instead of native ESM, local Three/static CSS, Chinese default, externalized static handlers and explicit dynamic listeners, smaller/foldable HUD, silent sound service, and a finite in-memory game-key allowlist. Original inputs remain available for review; generated artifacts and exact hashes live in `packages/frontend/public/games/local-lab/server-survival/provenance.json`.

The runtime metrics control groups all five original stats/score/health/monitoring/finance panel nodes in one scrollable drawer, preserving their original IDs, contents and game-local controls. Folding hides and makes every panel inert with synchronized ARIA; expanding stays above the construction toolbar, including narrow screens. It does not change metric values, monitoring unlocks, auto-repair costs or simulation rules.

Use a private temporary directory to install **esbuild 0.25.12 + tailwindcss 3.4.17** with `npm install --ignore-scripts --save-exact`; retain its complete lock as private build evidence. Set `LOCAL_LAB_BUILD_TOOLS` to that directory and run `node scripts/build-local-lab-strategy.mjs`. The script verifies versions/Three hash, downloads nothing and modifies no project dependency/lock file. Generated public assets are committed; ordinary frontend builds copy them without this toolchain.

The parent window loads `/games/local-lab/bridge.js` first and embeds this page in a script-only opaque-origin sandbox. The child CSP allows no connections, media, workers, nested frames or form navigation. Original script-time simulation remains unchanged; the common bridge freezes its timers/animation/clock while paused or hidden, and CSS animations stop too.

The game's save/load, campaign stars, settings and achievements are **current iframe session only**, cleared on close/reload/account remount. Browser-storage access is not attempted. Unsupported file import/export and external sharing/music controls are removed rather than left as broken buttons. There are no cloud saves, rooms, website rewards or website achievement claims.
